title: Boxes 21 to 23
logline: The garage in October: three new boxes at the end of the wall's row, 21, 22, 23, their lids lettered, the first of the private work already boxed and counted. The register is being kept.

panels.composition: The garage's long wall of numbered boxes, and at the row's end three newer ones — 21, 22, 23 — their lids lettered in marker, the 23rd's flaps still open with pages showing. The lamp on the table beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage wall of numbered cardboard boxes with three newer boxes at the end lettered 21, 22 and 23 in marker, the last one's flaps open with pages inside, a lit lamp on a table beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The private work, boxed and counted.
